..Title
Resolution to Approve Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc. for Certified Laboratory Water and Wastewater Testing Services in the Amount of $15,000.00 (Contract Total $250,000.00)
..Memorandum
Attached for your review and approval is a resolution to approve Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc. in the amount of $15,000.00 for water and wastewater testing services.

The City's Environmental Laboratory utilizes contract laboratories to perform specialized water testing analyses that cannot be performed at the City's laboratory. These analyses include both anticipated compliance monitoring as well as unanticipated special interest projects.

In 2022 the City issued RFP 22-54 for these services. Four proposals were received, and after an evaluation of the proposals, the City selected Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc. for their qualifications, quality of proposal, and competitive pricing. The City has been satisfied with their testing services provided by Trace and is now seeking Council authorization to increase the purchasing authority on the Agreement, which is set to expire on June 30, 2027, to cover the anticipated costs for the final term of the Public Services Agreement and including the 5% price increase requested.

Budget/Fiscal Impact: Funding for this amendment is available in the approved FY27 Public Services Area Water Supply System and Sewage Disposal System operation and maintenance budgets and will be available in future year fiscal budgets if so, approved by council.
..Staff
Prepared by:   Joel Guild, Environmental Laboratory Supervisor
Reviewed by:  Molly Maciejewski, Water Treatment Services Manager
Reviewed by:  Jordan Roberts, Public Services Administrator
Approved by:  Milton Dohoney Jr., City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, The City has a contract with Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc., that expires on June 30, 2027, for water and wastewater testing services;

Whereas, The City been satisfied with the testing services that Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc. has provided and would like to increase the purchasing authority to cover the anticipated cost of these services which is estimated to be $15,000.00; 

Whereas, Funding for the analysis is available in the appropriate approved Water Supply System and Sewage Disposal System operations and maintenance budgets and will be available in future year fiscal budgets if so, approved by council; and 

Whereas, Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc. complies with the requirements of the City's Living Wage and Non-Discrimination ordinances;

RESOLVED, That City Council approve Amendment Number 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Trace Analytical Laboratories, Inc. in the amount of $15,000.00 for a total not to exceed the amount of $250,000.00, which includes a 5% price increase, for specialized laboratory testing;

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized and directed to execute said agreement after approval as to substance by the City Administrator and approval as to form by the City Attorney;

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take all necessary actions to implement this resolution including approval and execution of any authorized extensions; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take the necessary actions to implement this resolution.
